method: System allocator counts bytes and blocks, checked after EVERY round after output/model drops and cache.clear. Five warm-ups; inputs excluded. RSS sampled with the child paused after drops at 20 checkpoints. Cache capacity may remain until cache drop. Weak owners test eviction, clear and final external Arc drop. Separate forgotten-allocation control detects 4096 bytes / 1 block. Instrumented timings are NOT CPU benchmarks.
